description: Produce a correct, faster implementation of PKB problem 1, an all-reduce sum over one tensor.

constraints: Preserve the solution function signature and all-rank sum semantics.
Assume the PKB default world size of 8 for this provisional generation test.

reference_implementation:
import torch
import torch.distributed as dist


@torch.no_grad()
def solution(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    out = tensor.clone()
    dist.all_reduce(out, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM)
    return out
